label: Stained Glass

traits.medium: luminous stained-glass-looking cloud artwork built from translucent jewel-colored panes
traits.texture: subtle rippled glass surfaces, dark leading and light passing through colored panes
traits.composition: pane shapes follow the original cloud lobes and broad sky; avoid random decorative symbols
traits.lighting: backlit cream cloud panes against deep blue sky panes

review_checks: cloud silhouette organizes the pane layout
limitations: No fabrication pattern, cut lines or structurally validated glazing design is supplied.
Palette and fine geometry are prompt guidance and require visual review across a series.
